parent_channels.name: Release from Containment into Exposure

subchannels.name: Ground Releasing Its Burdens
subchannels.scene_or_process: The ground acts as a containing substrate whose weighted contents are extracted into the open.
subchannels.active_motifs: enclosing ground `ء ر ض:B001/m01`; extraction from concealment `خ ر ج:B002/m01`; physical heaviness `ث ق ل:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The earth supplies the lower container, extraction supplies the outward operation, and heaviness characterizes what is released, forming a compact scene of a burdened interior opening onto the surface.

subchannels.name: Departure along an Outgoing Route
subchannels.scene_or_process: A participant leaves a prior station and proceeds along a route that carries movement away from its source.
subchannels.active_motifs: exit and separation `خ ر ج:B001/m01`; departure from a watering place `ص د ر:B003/m01`; well-traveled route `ع م ل:B011/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Exit supplies the boundary crossing, departure supplies the source-to-away direction, and the worked road supplies the conducting setting for outward movement.

subchannels.name: Hidden Content Made Manifest
subchannels.scene_or_process: Concealed information or action is brought out, displayed, and made available to perception.
subchannels.active_motifs: explicit disclosure `ح د ث:B006/m01`; release from ignorance or concealment `خ ر ج:B002/m02`; caused display `ر ء ي:B012/m01`; secret transmission `و ح ي:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: A hidden message first exists in covert transmission, then crosses into disclosure and finally becomes an intentionally shown object of perception.

subchannels.name: Dispersion across an Open Field
subchannels.scene_or_process: Compact matter or a gathered population is separated into many units and spread over space.
subchannels.active_motifs: scattering grains or powder `ذ ر ر:B002/m01`; dispersed groups `ش ت ت:B001/m01`; goods spread for drying `ش ر ر:B002/m01`; diffused sunrise `ذ ر ر:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Scattering supplies the operation, divided groups and particles supply its mobile units, and the drying surface or spreading light supplies the open field over which they disperse.

subchannels.name: Shredding into Expelled Fragments
subchannels.scene_or_process: A compact object is cut apart and its resulting fragments are extracted and scattered.
subchannels.active_motifs: cutting and shredding `ش ر ر:B004/m01`; extraction from concealment `خ ر ج:B002/m01`; scattering grains or powder `ذ ر ر:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Cutting creates separate pieces, extraction removes them from the original mass, and scattering distributes the fragments beyond it.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: What is enclosed, hidden, or concentrated crosses a boundary and becomes outwardly present.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 99:2 — أَخْرَجَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا; 99:6 — يَصْدُرُ, أَشْتَاتًا, لِّيُرَوْا; 99:7-8 — مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ, يَرَهُ.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same transition extends from geological release to departure routes, disclosure, sprinkled particles, and goods spread beneath the sun.

parent_channels.name: Cultivated Terrain and Its Yield

subchannels.name: Soft Earth Holding Water
subchannels.scene_or_process: Low, workable soil receives and retains abundant clear water.
subchannels.active_motifs: fertile soft earth `ء ر ض:B002/m01`; low wet ground `خ ب ر:B002/m01`; abundant fresh water `ر ب ب:B013/m01`; clear palatable water `ز ل ز ل:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: A soft depression in the earth functions as the receiving basin, while copious and clear water supplies the material condition for fertility.

subchannels.name: Germination into a Green Cover
subchannels.scene_or_process: Rooted growth rises from fertile ground and develops into a soft, persistent plant covering.
subchannels.active_motifs: rooted abundant growth `ء ر ض:B002/m02`; evergreen herb `ر ب ب:B012/m01`; named herb `ش ر ر:B012/m01`; tender vegetation `خ ب ر:B005/m01`; emerging sprout `ذ ر ر:B004/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Fertile ground anchors the roots, tender and evergreen plants fill the surface, and the delicate rising shoot marks the transition from soil to living cover.

subchannels.name: Clouds Persisting over the Land
subchannels.scene_or_process: Clouds emerge, gather in layers, persist, and carry the rain that sustains vegetation.
subchannels.active_motifs: cloud emergence and clearing `خ ر ج:B005/m01`; layered rain cloud `ر ب ب:B008/m01`; persistent cloud `ر ب ب:B007/m02`; cloudlike foam `خ ب ر:B005/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: Emerging cloud, layered accumulation, and atmospheric persistence form a rain-bearing sequence, with foam supplying a parallel image for the cloud's soft piled surface.

subchannels.name: Cultivation, Bargain, and Crop Share
subchannels.scene_or_process: A cultivator works land under a negotiated share arrangement that converts produce into an allotted yield.
subchannels.active_motifs: farmer and sharecropping `خ ب ر:B003/m01`; commercial dealing `ع م ل:B005/m01`; negotiation `ق و ل:B009/m01`; assessed yield or levy `خ ر ج:B003/m01`; giving from abundance `خ ي ر:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Farming supplies the productive operation, negotiation and dealing establish the share, and the outgoing yield becomes the portion transferred as payment or gift.

subchannels.name: Settled Tenancy on Worked Ground
subchannels.scene_or_process: A cultivator remains attached to a tract of land through continuing residence and agricultural tenure.
subchannels.active_motifs: adherence to the ground `ء ر ض:B006/m01`; residence and persistence `ر ب ب:B007/m01`; farmer and sharecropping `خ ب ر:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Ground-adherence fixes the cultivator spatially, residence extends that attachment through time, and sharecropping gives the settled relation its productive function.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Ground becomes productive through softness, water, persistent growth, and organized human cultivation.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 99:1-2 — أَرْضُ; 99:4 — أَخْبَارَ; 99:5 — رَبَّ; 99:7 — خَيْرًا, while their active senses form an agricultural scene.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Earthquake vocabulary reaches clear water, news vocabulary reaches wet soil and farming, and lordship vocabulary reaches rain clouds and evergreen plants.

parent_channels.name: Destabilization, Inertia, and Involuntary Motion

subchannels.name: Quake, Shiver, and Murmur
subchannels.scene_or_process: Oscillation passes from the ground into a shivering body and is accompanied by a low sound.
subchannels.active_motifs: seismic shaking `ز ل ز ل:B001/m01`; bodily shiver `ء ر ض:B008/m01`; torpid bodily resistance `ث ق ل:B006/m01`; faint sound `و ح ي:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The quake and human shiver share oscillatory motion, while bodily heaviness resists that motion and the faint voice gives it an audible edge.

subchannels.name: Grounded Inertia versus Sudden Speed
subchannels.scene_or_process: A body clings to the ground and moves heavily until the opposite impulse of speed breaks the stasis.
subchannels.active_motifs: ground-adherence and delay `ء ر ض:B006/m02`; physical heaviness `ث ق ل:B001/m01`; slow heavy tread `ث ق ل:B006/m02`; rapid action `و ح ي:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Grounded adherence, mass, and slow tread form an inertial state; rapid action supplies its functional reversal and releases movement.

subchannels.name: Apparition and Compelled Bodily Motion
subchannels.scene_or_process: A human encounters a jinn apparition and exhibits uncontrolled movement of head and body.
subchannels.active_motifs: possessed involuntary motion `ء ر ض:B012/m01`; jinn apparition `ر ء ي:B008/m01`; human kind opposed to jinn `ء ن س:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The human-jinn contrast supplies the participants, apparition supplies the encounter, and involuntary bodily motion supplies its visible outcome.

subchannels.name: Calamity as a Destabilizing Shock
subchannels.scene_or_process: A severe event interrupts ordinary continuity and is experienced as a temporal quake.
subchannels.active_motifs: hardships of time `ز ل ز ل:B002/m01`; calamity or adverse event `ح د ث:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The physical vocabulary of shaking is transferred to the upheavals of time, while the event root supplies the incident that delivers the shock.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Force is registered as a loss of stable control, ranging from oscillation to slowed resistance or compelled bodily movement.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 99:1 — زُلْزِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا; 99:2 — أَثْقَالَهَا; 99:3 — ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ; 99:4 — تُحَدِّثُ; 99:5 — أَوْحَىٰ.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The terrestrial quake becomes a human shiver, a faint murmur, torpor, and a possessed body's involuntary movement.

parent_channels.name: From Perception and Judgment to Discourse

subchannels.name: Detection Followed by Inquiry
subchannels.scene_or_process: A perceiver notices something, turns attention toward it, and asks for an informative account.
subchannels.active_motifs: visual detection `ء ن س:B002/m01`; auditory detection `ء ن س:B002/m02`; felt apprehension `ء ن س:B002/m03`; interrogative attention `ر ء ي:B013/m01`; knowledge of an interior matter `خ ب ر:B001/m01`; calling or asking `و ح ي:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Sight or hearing initiates attention, inquiry seeks what lies beneath the appearance, and the call requests that hidden knowledge be supplied.

subchannels.name: Deliberation and Choosing the Better Course
subchannels.scene_or_process: Expert knowledge enters reflection and produces a reasoned selection.
subchannels.active_motifs: deliberative judgment `ر ء ي:B002/m01`; interior expertise `خ ب ر:B001/m01`; choosing or seeking the better `خ ي ر:B003/m01`; cultivated learning `ر ب ب:B003/m01`; supposition `ق و ل:B011/m01`; formed belief `ق و ل:B013/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Experience supplies the matter known, cultivated learning stabilizes it, reflection compares alternatives, and choice converts judgment into a preferred course.

subchannels.name: Inner Saying Becoming Utterance
subchannels.scene_or_process: A saying exists inwardly, is drawn into the self, and then crosses into spoken or covert communication.
subchannels.active_motifs: unspoken inner saying `ق و ل:B012/m01`; inward appropriation of a saying `ق و ل:B006/m01`; inner self `ء ن س:B006/m01`; articulated utterance `ق و ل:B001/m01`; hidden communication `و ح ي:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The same-root movement from inward saying to voiced speech is complemented by covert communication, which externalizes content without requiring full public articulation.

subchannels.name: News Becoming a Circulating Account
subchannels.scene_or_process: Knowledge of an occurrence is renewed as narration and carried among speakers.
subchannels.active_motifs: renewed speech or report `ح د ث:B003/m01`; news of an interior matter `خ ب ر:B001/m02`; prolific speaker `ق و ل:B003/m01`; circulating talk `ق و ل:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: An occurrence becomes report, report becomes repeated narration, and repeated narration becomes speech circulating through a community.

subchannels.name: Definition, Signification, and Grammatical Framing
subchannels.scene_or_process: A concept is bounded by a definition, indicated by an expression, and framed by a quantifying particle.
subchannels.active_motifs: formal definition `ق و ل:B016/m01`; nonhuman signification `ق و ل:B014/m01`; quantifying particle `ر ب ب:B015/m01`; source of an expression or act `ص د ر:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Definition fixes conceptual limits, signification points to the bounded thing, and the quantifying particle determines how that content enters an utterance.

subchannels.name: Fabricated Claim Departing from Its Origin
subchannels.scene_or_process: A newly invented statement is falsely attributed and moves away from an established source or communal norm.
subchannels.active_motifs: new occurrence `ح د ث:B001/m01`; fabricated attribution `ق و ل:B005/m01`; departure from origin or obedience `خ ر ج:B006/m01`; hidden communication `و ح ي:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Novel formation supplies the invented content, false attribution assigns it to another source, and departure from origin names the resulting deviation from established speech.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Perceived or inwardly formed content is examined, selected, formulated, and communicated.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 99:3 — قَالَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ; 99:4 — تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا; 99:5 — أَوْحَىٰ; 99:6-8 — لِّيُرَوْا أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ, يَعْمَلْ, يَرَهُ.
